description_en: Queries a UserId by the bound third-party account ID
description_zh: 根据绑定的第三方账号ID查询UserId
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public query-user-by-mobile-account --mobile-user-id sasda --mobile-type ding --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryUserByMobileAccount

parameters.help_en:
The bound mobile user ID.

DingTalk: The unionId of the DingTalk account.
WeCom: The userId of the WeCom account.
Lark: The userId of the Lark account.
<notice>The mobileUserId must be obtained by calling the relevant API operations of DingTalk, WeCom, or Lark.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
绑定移动端用户ID

钉钉：钉钉账号的unionId
企业微信：企微账号的userId
飞书：飞书账号的userId
<notice>mobileUserId需要开发者自行调用钉钉、企微、飞书的相关接口获取。></notice>
parameters.name: mobile_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The bound mobile type.

DingTalk: ding
WeCom: corp_weixin
Lark: feishu
parameters.help_zh:
绑定移动端类型

钉钉：ding
企业微信：corp_weixin
飞书：feishu
parameters.name: mobile_type

Result.description_en: The user information bound to the third-party account
Result.description_zh: 三方账号绑定的用户信息

BoundUserId.description_en: The Quick BI user ID of the bound account
BoundUserId.description_zh: 被绑定账号的Quick BI用户ID

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
